title: (Senior) Product Manager - Customer Taxation (m/f/d)
description:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the  FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.
 Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from  more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.
 Team 
 Raisin helps customers grow their wealth through savings and investments without barriers. But even the best products and the smoothest experience lose their value if customers pay more tax than they need to, or have to work out, declare and settle their taxes themselves. The Customer Taxation Team makes sure they don’t.  We design how tax works in Raisin’s tax-advantaged products, a growing part of our offer. Examples include the new Raisin Cash ISA in the UK and the Raisin Kinderdepot, a children’s investment account that uses the child’s tax allowances automatically. We also calculate and withhold tax on the interest and returns customers earn, handle their tax exemption orders and non-assessment certificates, and provide the annual tax documents they need for their tax return. And we send the tax reports that authorities require. 
 Raisin is available in many European countries, each with its own tax rules and reporting duties. As new regulations come to our platform, we make sure Raisin complies. You will lead a cross-functional team and work closely with Legal, Compliance, Country Management, Product Operations, Customer Service, Data, and external tax and banking partners. Our goal is for customers to trust that their tax is right, find it easy to manage, use the tax allowances they are entitled to, and have peace of mind.
 Your Responsibilities 
 You will own a regulated domain that customers depend on every tax year. Working with an experienced Engineering Lead, you will become the go-to expert for customer taxation at Raisin.
 Own customer taxation end to end: Define the vision and roadmap together with Product and Engineering leadership. Take each topic from discovery to delivery to measured impact. Decide what we build first, and keep stakeholders aligned on priorities, risks and trade-offs.
 Keep tax accurate and reliable: Agree with Legal, Compliance and country managers on what correct looks like. Work with Engineering so calculation, documents and reporting stay stable and easy to extend.
 Grow Raisin’s tax proposition: Shape how tax works when Raisin enters new markets, launches tax-advantaged products or brings on new partners. Find where we can take tax work off customers’ hands, so they don’t have to declare and settle it themselves.
 Turn complex rules into simple experiences: Translate the  tax rules behind each launch into clear requirements with the edge cases covered. Design the customer experience and see the work through to delivery.
 Hit the deadlines that cannot move: Make sure annual tax documents and statutory reports go out correct and on time, working with Product Operations. Plan backwards from fixed dates and monitor data quality.
 Catch errors before they reach customers, and escalate early when a date is at risk.
 Make tax effortless for customers: Keep self-service for tax exemption orders and non-assessment certificates intuitive, so customers get them right the first time. Give Customer Service the tools to answer tax questions fast, especially around tax season.
 Shape the team culture: Give and ask for feedback openly, share wins with the team, and treat mistakes as a reason to fix the process.
 Your Profile 
 Must haves: 
 3+ years of product management experience, including ownership of a technical product such as a back-end, platform or data-heavy service.
 Experience leading a cross-functional product team and getting engineers and stakeholders behind shared priorities.
 Experience launching new products or taking products into new markets, with the precision to get every edge case right, because one wrong tax rule can affect thousands of customers.
 Strong analytical skills and the habit of checking and reconciling numbers yourself.
 Curiosity about tax and a drive to make it feel easy for customers, even when the rules behind it are not.
 The ability to learn fast, take feedback well and change course when new facts come in.
 Energy, a strong work ethic and a hands-on attitude to detailed work.
 Clear, structured written English, and the confidence to explain trade-offs to senior leaders and say no with a reason.
 Nice to haves: 
 Experience in a regulated field such as banking, payments, insurance or tax technology.
 Strong knowledge of the tax regime in one or more of Raisin’s markets, for example Germany (Abgeltungsteuer, tax exemption orders), or of statutory reporting such as CRS. Tax knowledge is not required. We will teach you.
 You have built tools for operations or customer service teams.
 Important attributes for this role: 
 You bridge product and engineering. You are comfortable discussing data models and architecture trade-offs, and you push for practical solutions that scale.
 Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us! 
 At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.
 As part of our team, you will benefit from
 Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year.
 Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days.
 A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%.
 Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Spo

title: Senior Product Manager, B2C
description:

 Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours. 
 Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to  getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Your role involves creating and executing a vision for a product area, constantly learning from our customers, and iterating to improve the user experience. You will also collaborate with our UX team, composed of product designers, researchers, and writers.
 We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who can envision GetYourGuide beyond its current state, champion our users' voices, and execute a compelling vision. 
 Successful PMs at GetYourGuide bring a growth mindset and drive business and customer impact by identifying opportunities, getting buy-in from your stakeholders, and executing with urgency.
 What You'll Do

Build alignment across cross-functional teams, partner teams, and senior stakeholders.

 Demonstrated ownership of a significant product area with responsibilities for strategy, KPI definition, goal-setting, and roadmap execution.
 Ability to build alignment with a cross-functional mission team in a collaborative way that is aligned with our Guiding Principles.
 Strong ability to lead in ambiguity, influence without authority, and align multiple teams around shared outcomes.
 Strong data analytics skills with the ability to derive insights from large data sets.
 Demonstrated passion for driving customer and business impact.

 Bonus: Experience working in a marketplace or the travel industry is a plus, but not required.

 And more…

title: Product Manager - Engagement — Remote, $150k-300k/yr inc equity
description:
**About AIOS**
==============
**AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.**
We’re at $400M ARR, growing from $10M/yr 12 months ago. We’re the world’s fastest growing AI doctor.
We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’re profitable.
Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:
* The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.
* The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.
Our master plan:
* **Step 0 $100M/yr by end of 2025**: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.
* **Step 1 $1B ARR by end of 2026**: Over the last 12 months we've grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.
* **Step 2 $10B ARR by end of 2028**: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.
* **Step 3 $100B/yr by end of 2031**: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.
* **Step 4 $1T/yr by end of 2035**: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.
In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.
We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.
You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS
**Being a Product Manager - Engagement at AIOS**
------------------------------------------------
We are building a world-class team.
As Product Manager - Engagement at AIOS (Bolt Pharmacy), your fundamental role is to make the app experience essential to the customer journey. You’ll turn a run of the mill medication delivery app into a product customers come back to daily, and one that is impactful enough they can’t help but bring their network with them.
This is first of its kind work: you'll be designing and shipping the features that make customers feel supported on their weight loss journey, despite many people on GLP-1s initially wanting to go it alone.
Concretely, you'll build and iterate on social functionality, including ‘Circles’, a private group concept where users invite friends and family to cheer them on.
You will own our ‘Freemium’ model that brings in supporters, curious prospective users and existing customers of competitors to our app. You will make the whole journey more social, less lonely, and easier to talk about, driving retention and new user growth in the process.
This is a full-time, fully remote role. You can work async in the timezone of your choice, provided you have sufficient overlap with European and US time zones (mid day Pacific Time) when needed.
You'll report directly to our Head of Product (Ben Dowdle).
You’ll also work most closely with our nascent Engagement Pod, consisting of you, a product designer, and a lean engineering team.
**Key responsibilities**
------------------------
* Engagement & Social Direction: You own the roadmap for everything that turns the app from a delivery utility into something people genuinely want to open every day.
* Community Building: You lead our work on Circles (private user groups), the product experience that turns a solitary journey into a supported one and builds real community around the GLP-1 experience.
* Freemium Growth: You build and own the freemium loop that pulls both existing and prospective GLP-1 users into the app, then turns them into our best source of new patients.
* Behavioural Design: You'll work at the intersection of behavioural design, growth loops, and clinical constraints. You’ll form and defend a strong point of view on what drives ongoing engagement in a category where sharing is high on stigma.
* Research: You'll own the research needed to form your strong point of view. You’ll work closely with design and engineering to refine direction, proving impact against retention, engagement and growth metrics.
* Metrics Ownership: You define and own the numbers that prove your strategy is working (weekly active users, retention, freemium-to-customer conversion etc.). You can clearly speak through your metrics with the team.
**Need to have**
----------------
* Consumer App Experience: 5+ years as a Product Manager on consumer apps, with a clear track record of 0 to 1 product development as a Senior Product Manager.
* Social Product Chops: You've built social, community, and/or growth-focused conversion features. You understand what makes users come back and bring others with them.
* Growth/engagement fluency: You think in growth mechanics (freemium conversion, retention curves, activation funnels). You upskill your pod quickly to get them aligned on what actually moves the needle.
* Independence: You take loosely defined, ambiguous problems and run with them end to end without needing much steering. You own the hypothesis, roadmap, and the outcome.
* Data Fluency: You understand the criticality of accurate data. You detest obfuscated metrics and strive for the base truth. You’ve previously defined a new metric, and/or refined a fuzzy metric.
* Research background: You run your own qualitative and quantitative research rather than waiting for it to be handed to you. You run multiple tests in parallel without getting overwhelmed.
* Clockspeed: You move fast and ship in weekly sprint cycles, not quarters. You'd rather get something in front of users and learn versus perfecting it in a doc and delaying.
**Nice to have**
----------------
* Regulated or sensitive-category experience: You don't need healthcare experience, but experience in a category where users are hesitant to share (health, finance, dating) is a strong plus, since you understand stigma as a design constraint
* Startup Experience: You’ve operated in an early-stage company or built something yourself.

title: Product Manager, Marketplace

---------------------------
Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission: 
**Vinted Marketplace** is Europe's leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life. 
**Vinted Go** enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces. 
**Vinted Pay** is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

**Information about the position**
----------------------------------
We're looking for Product Managers to join Vinted Marketplace within our Security domain. title: Scientific Product Manager (m/fd)
description:
Your mission
 Who We Are
 NeuroNation is the personalised training app that empowers more than 20 million people all over the world in staying brain healthy and happy in their lives.
We collaborate closely with scientists and universities to achieve the best results possible. Our engaging apps have received awards from major health insurance companies, such as the AOK, funded by the German Federal Ministry of Health. Also, we've been awarded by Apple and Google as one of the best apps available.
To improve the training experience our app provides and make the product more effective and engaging to users and patients, we are looking for a passionate person with a background in science and deep interest in digital health and games. Since the role touches many different fields, you don’t have to bring all know-how already with you - we are welcoming passionate learners who want to develop themselves in this role.
So, if you want to help us shape a better tomorrow, join us on our journey!
 Your Roles And Responsibilities
 Improve the training experience and the exercises of our mobile and web app by making NeuroNation as effective and engaging as possible
 Continuously incorporate the latest findings from neuroscience by reading scientific papers and learning from concepts that have been proven to have impact on clinical outcomes
 Apply User Research and Usability Testing to learn how we can best help users and patients, and define useful features and visual concepts
 Collaborate with our scientific partners from various universities and clinics to run successful clinical trials with NeuroNation
 Analyse massive amounts of data continuously collected from millions of users to drive optimal decisions in product development
 Run A/B tests to experiment with new ideas
 Be your own user, assure the quality of the product, and become one of the experts for cognitive training
 Live with a Growth mindset - constantly look for learning opportunities for yourself and the team
 Work closely with colleagues from Marketing, Business Intelligence, Customer Care, and CRM
 Join the Growth and Product teams to collaboratively help millions of users and patients to stay fit
 Your profile
 Who You Are And What You Have Done
 You have a deep personal interest in BRAIN TRAINING and SELF-IMPROVEMENT
 You have at least 2 years of working experience in Neuroscience, Cognitive Science, Psychology, or related fields
 You are a passionate learner
 You have personal experience as a user of digital health, education, or productivity apps
 You have personal experience as a user of digital games
 Excellent written and oral communication skills in both German and English.
 You have strong problem-solving skills
 You have a deep interest in analysing engagement, retention, and other behavioural data
 You are well-organised and have good project management skills. You can multi-task and manage multiple tasks concurrently.
 You are a team-player and love to help out your colleagues.
 Bonus: You have experience with Games or Gamification
 Bonus: You have experience or talent with UX or Visual Design
 Bonus: You have knowledge of SQL, R, or Python
 Bonus: You hold a PhD in Neuroscience, Cognitive Science, or Psychology
 Why us?
 Flexible working hours with core hours, so you can balance sport, hobbies, and career
 A hybrid role in Berlin — 3 days in the office, 2 remote
 An office at Gendarmenmarkt with events, a roof terrace, snacks, and drinks
 A bespoke onboarding programme to get you up to speed on the role, products, and teams fast
 A clear working structure where initiative and creativity are valued
 Flat hierarchies and an open feedback culture
 Varied tasks in a dynamic, innovative environment
 An energetic, motivated, well-organised team
 Team events and workshops
 Sponsored gym and sports-class memberships
 Deutschland-Ticket
 A €1,000 personal development budget
 About Us
 For 15 years, we have been developing digital training programs that are proven to enhance cognitive performance and are easily accessible to people worldwide. Today, our health app NeuroNation is available in 13 different languages and is used by over 30 million people. Our cognitive therapy program, NeuroNation MED , has been permanently approved as a digital health application by the Federal Institute for Drugs and Medical Devices and supports approximately one-quarter of all patients with mild cognitive impairment (ICD-10 F06.7) in Germany. Our long-term goal is to establish the first virtual clinic for cognitive and mental health.
 Why You Should Join NeuroNation
 We build science-backed brain-training and digital cognitive therapy that reaches millions of people. Your work here will shape how people care for their minds every day.
 Impactful Work: Working with us means contributing to a product that profoundly impacts cognitive health. Our brain training programs, backed by cutting-edge neuroscience and cognitive psychology, are designed to enhance cognitive functions, improve working memory, and elevate our users' quality of life.
 Inspiring Environment: At NeuroNation, you'll join a vibrant team of passionate and innovative professionals. We believe that collaboration and creativity thrive in a fun and inclusive environment. From team-building activities to spontaneous brainstorming sessions, we make sure that work is both productive and enjoyable.
 Flexible hours: Our flexible working hours and remote work policy let you tailor your work schedule to fit your lifestyle, ensuring you can perform at your best.

title: Founder Associate - Portfolio Opportunities
description:
Founder Associate Opportunities: One Application, Access Across 150+ Portfolio Companies 
 We know what it's like working with founders at Atlantic and FoodLabs. When they're building something genuinely new - whether it's the future of food systems or the next breakthrough in tech - they move at a pace that doesn't always sync with traditional hiring timelines. When they need someone brilliant to join them, they need them now.
 And we've met so many of you - sharp, ambitious people just starting your careers - who are doing everything right. You're tailoring cover letters, tracking applications in spreadsheets, refreshing job boards. But here's the frustrating part: by the time a role gets posted publicly, the founder might have already been looking for weeks. You're often one step behind through no fault of your own.
 We think there's a better way.
 We're building a direct connection between exceptional early-career professionals and founders across our network looking for Founder Associates. Here's how it works: you apply once, tell us your story, and we make sure the right founders see your profile when they're ready to hire - often before they've even written a job description. It's like getting early access to opportunities that are tailor-made for someone like you...
 How It Works 
 You submit one application. Your profile gets reviewed by our team, then shared selectively with founders who are actively hiring for these roles. When there's a strong match, they reach out directly.
 This includes both publicly listed roles and stealth opportunities that haven't been announced yet.
 What You're Signing Up For 
 Founder Associate roles are high-impact, high-ownership positions for people who want to operate close to the core of a business. You'll work directly with founders on their highest-priority problems—the kind that don't fit neatly into a function or department.
 The scope varies by company, but typically includes:
 Driving strategic projects across ops, growth, fundraising, or partnerships
 Owning end-to-end execution on critical work streams
 Building financial models, dashboards, competitive analysis, or internal systems
 Acting as a trusted operator and thought partner to the founding team
 Moving between problems quickly—solving what matters most, not what's clearly defined
 This is for people who thrive in ambiguity, want broad exposure, and prefer building to optimising.
 What Strong Candidates Bring 
 A solid academic background (business, economics, engineering, or adjacent fields)
 Early experience in consulting, banking, venture, startups, or high-growth tech
 Strong analytical and quantitative skills
 High ownership, initiative, and follow-through
 Clear, concise communication
 Strong organisation and prioritisation
 Comfort with pace, ambiguity, and lightly structured environments
 A bias toward execution
 Why Apply This Way 
 📢 One application, multiple opportunities
 🌅 Early access to roles before they're publicly listed
 🔥 Direct founder outreach when there's a strong fit
 🎯 Tailored matching by role type, sector, and stage
 The Process 
 1️⃣ You apply - share your background, skills, interests, and availability (internship or full-time)
 2️⃣ We review - our team evaluates your profile
 3️⃣ Founders connect - your profile is shared with relevant founders who are actively hiring, and they reach out directly if interested.
 You can still apply independently to any open roles - this simply increases your visibility earlier in the process.

description:

 Buena macht alles rund um Immobilien so einfach und transparent wie den Kauf eines ETFs – von der Suche und Finanzierung bis zum Kauf und zur Verwaltung. Dafür übernehmen wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland und entwickeln sie mit eigener Software, besseren Prozessen und starken Teams weiter. Unterstützt von GV arbeiten wir daran, mehr Menschen den Zugang zu Wohneigentum und damit zum Vermögensaufbau zu ermöglichen.
 Über die Rolle
 Du arbeitest direkt mit Din Bisevac, unserem Co-Founder und CEO, an Buena's wichtigsten Herausforderungen. D.h. vom Investor Reporting, bis zur Mitarbeit in einzelnen Divisions, kann jede Aufgabe bei dir landen.
Dein Aufgabenbereich wächst mit der Firma. Daher solltest du Freude daran haben, dich schnell in unbekannte Themen einzuarbeiten, dir fundierte eigene Meinungen zu bilden und Verantwortung zu übernehmen, bevor dir jemand detaillierte Arbeitsaufträge gibt.

 Interdisziplinäres Problem-Solving. Du übernimmst Aufgaben in Operations und Product. Dies kann in Form von Projektstrukturierung oder regulärer Mitarbeit sein.

 Schon früh außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse erzielt hast, sei dies in deinem eigenen Unternehmen, in einem schnell wachsenden Startups oder einem etablierten Unternehmen.

 Aufstiegschancen in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Startups Europas.
 MacBook & Studio Display.

title: Entrepreneur in Residence
description:

 Identifying and validating market opportunities across media categories, geographies and platforms

Typically, your profile will look like this:
 Degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, or related analytical field from a top-tier university
 3+ years of direct venture development and business building experience in high-growth startups or indirectly via Tier 1 consultancies and leading investment firms
 Expert-level proficiency in business model innovation, operational system design, and strategic financial modelling
 Self-starter who excels with minimal guidance and has demonstrable experience building initiatives from concept to execution
 Strategic thinker with exceptional execution capabilities and proven track record translating market insights into successful business outcomes
 You thrive in a fast-paced and performance-oriented environment
 Colleagues would describe you as hard-working, ambitious and persistent

 What Makes This Exciting
 You are one of the first employees of an ambitious team, changing the world of media and entertainment. Being early means every decision you make shapes our trajectory. Flat hierarchies mean that your voice matters, your ideas get implemented, and your impact is immediate.

 We hire on a rolling basis. Earliest starting date is always ASAP.

 Offer, Contract signing and Onboarding

 Strategisches Denken: Sie haben Freude daran, über den Tellerrand hinauszublicken, Chancen zu identifizieren und Zukunftsthemen aktiv mitzugestalten. Dabei arbeiten Sie selbstständig und bringen Themen mit hoher Verlässlichkeit zum Abschluss.
 Vertrauenswürdigkeit: Diskretion, Loyalität und ein professioneller Umgang mit sensiblen Informationen sind für Sie selbstverständlich.
